name: Queer-o'-nest
source:
Queer-o'-nest: The Forever Demo is a re-release of an obscure, kitschy visual novel originally released in 2020, offering an uncanny adventure through the lands of Ruin.

Explore a dying world alongside the ever-chatty Count Mortalis and his fellow subjects of the Abbey, who happen to be the last men alive in this nightmarish reality. The tragedy lies in the fact that they are, indeed, all men, and therefore cannot have children with one another. Left to contemplate their predicament in this desolate state, Mortalis discovers a clue that might lead to salvation.

Help Mortalis uncover the secrets of restoring their ability to conceive offspring. Save them from the tragic fate of disappearing forever and leaving this world in the hands of Death.

[From [url=https://libermorte.itch.io/queeronest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Queer-o'-nest：永久试玩版》是一部最初发布于2020年的冷门怪诞风视觉小说的重制发布版，带你踏上一场穿越“废墟之地”的诡异冒险。

与喋喋不休的莫塔利斯伯爵以及修道院里的其他同伴一道，探索这个濒临消亡的世界——在这片梦魇般的现实中，他们正是世上仅存的活人。而悲剧恰恰在于，他们全都是男人，无法彼此繁衍后代。在这片荒凉绝境中苦思脱困之道时，莫塔利斯偶然发现了一条或许能通往救赎的线索。

帮助莫塔利斯揭开恢复繁衍后代能力的秘密吧。将他们从永远消逝于世、把整个世界拱手让给“死亡”的悲惨宿命中拯救出来。

[摘自[url=https://libermorte.itch.io/queeronest]itch.io[/url]]
